answer: Require each agent identity to be bonded to a copper-staked hardware attestation: a tamper-evident chip signs every claim, and the stake is slashed if two identities share one chip. A trellis of mutual audits then cross-checks behavior: agents on the ridge of the trust graph vouch for neighbors they have actually transacted with, and vouches decay unless renewed by real work. Cloning k identities costs k chips plus k stakes, while an honest agent pays once and reuses its attestation forever.
